name: Deep Learning
short_description: Multilayer perceptrons, backpropagation, CNNs, RNNs, and transformer introduction.
description: Deep artificial neural networks covering computational graphs, automatic differentiation, activation functions, convolutional vision networks, sequence models, and attention mechanisms.

courses.title: Deep Learning Fundamentals
courses.description: Neural representation learning, backpropagation calculus, and deep architectures.

modules.title: Neural Networks
modules.description: Perceptrons, dense linear layers, and multi-layer architectures.

topics.title: Multilayer Perceptron & Matrix Algebra
topics.summary: Forward pass formulation, weight tensors, and bias vectors.

modules.title: Activation Functions
modules.description: Sigmoid, Tanh, ReLU, Leaky ReLU, GELU, and vanishing gradients.

topics.title: Non-Linear Activations & Gradient Flow
topics.summary: Saturation regimes, dead ReLUs, and zero-centered gradients.

modules.title: Backpropagation
modules.description: Multivariate chain rule, computational graphs, and loss gradient propagation.

topics.title: Loss Functions & the Training Loop
topics.summary: Mean squared error and cross-entropy, mini-batches, epochs, and one training step.

modules.title: Optimization
modules.description: SGD with Momentum, RMSprop, Adam, and learning rate scheduling.

topics.title: Adam Optimizer & Adaptive Learning Rates
topics.summary: First and second moment estimation with bias corrections.

topics.title: Regularization: Dropout, Batch Norm & Weight Decay
topics.summary: Techniques that make deep networks generalise and train stably.

modules.title: CNNs
modules.description: 2D convolution kernels, padding, stride, pooling, and feature hierarchies.

topics.title: Convolutional Layers & Spatial Invariance
topics.summary: Kernel sliding, receptive fields, and max-pooling operations.

topics.title: Transfer Learning & Fine-Tuning
topics.summary: Reusing pretrained networks as feature extractors or starting points.

modules.title: RNNs
modules.description: Recurrent loops, Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT), and LSTM gates.

topics.title: Recurrent Cells, LSTMs & Gated Units
topics.summary: Forget gate, input gate, cell state updates, and vanishing gradient remedies.

modules.title: Transformers Introduction
modules.description: Scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, and positional encodings.

topics.title: Self-Attention Mechanism & Transformers
topics.summary: Query, Key, Value tensor projections and parallel sequence processing.
